environment.copy.this.cannot.be.undone.a:
This cannot be undone.

All Discover pages, playback progress, watched records, watchlists, favorites, and other watch data in this environment will be deleted. Libraries, modules, and source collections used only here will also be deleted, without moving to the default environment.

Libraries and modules still used elsewhere will remain. Only this environment’s playback data reporting is disabled; reporting and data in other environments remain unchanged. Trakt sync transfers to the default environment. Remote media files are not deleted. With cloud sync enabled, deletion syncs to other devices.

If this environment is active, Rex will first switch to the default environment.
